speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the appearance of the rash on your palms, such as its color, texture, and whether it has spread to other areas? Also, when did you first notice the numbness and tingling sensations?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of diabetes or other metabolic conditions, and have you noticed any darkening of the skin on your neck or armpits? I would also like to check for any signs of peripheral neuropathy in your feet.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your occupational exposure to livestock and rice farming, I need to rule out a parasitic infection. Have you noticed any linear tracks or burrows on your skin, and does the itching intensify significantly at night? I will also examine the hypopigmented macules on your elbows for signs of sensory loss.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of your pruritic rash, peripheral neuropathy (numbness/tingling), and specifically the thinning of eyebrows and loss of eyelashes is highly suggestive of Hansen's disease (Leprosy). I need to confirm if there is any loss of sensation in the hypopigmented macules on your elbows. REQUEST TEST: Skin Biopsy
